title: Law to regulate chatbot data privacy and disclosure
summary: This bill would require companies offering chatbots to secure user data, let users access their own chat logs, and disclose clearly that users are talking to a bot rather than a human. It would bar chatbots from processing personal data for training or advertising without a user's affirmative consent, ban use by minors for training purposes, limit data retention to 10 years and prohibit chatbots from claiming to give advice equivalent to a licensed professional. Violations would carry civil penalties of up to $25,000 each, and the law would take effect 180 days after enactment.
